Show the most used list methods.

Supplied answer
nums = [1, 5, 2, 4, 6, 3]
nums.append(7) # add at the end
nums.insert(1, 10) # add 10 at index 1
nums.extend([8, 9]) # add many items
print(nums)
nums.remove(2) # remove the VALUE 2
nums.pop(0) # remove by INDEX and return it
nums.sort() # sort in place (ascending)
nums.sort(reverse=True) # descending
nums.reverse() # only reverse the order
print(nums, len(nums), nums.count(4), nums.index(4))
Note: remove() takes a value, pop() takes an index. append() adds one item, extend() adds many.
